events.title: Elisa Jane Carmichael Elisa Jane Carmichael | (BE)LONGING | Redcliffe Art Gallery
events.description: Elisa Jane Carmichael’s series Alive (2019) is now showing in (BE)LONGING at Redcliffe Art Gallery until 14th of November, 2026.

events.title: Elisa Jane Carmichael Elisa Jane Carmichael | A Connections: MCA x Tate
events.description: Elisa Jane Carmichael’s work, a search for meaning is to absorb the abundance of beauty in nature, is now showing in Connections: MCA x Tate at the Museum of Contemporary Art , Sydney.
